- For every pound of beeswax, he can make 10 tapered candles.

- He sells each candle for $2.00 each.
- He makes and sells 20 candles. Need net profit.

He makes and sells 20 candles. That requires 2 pounds of beeswax (since 1 lb = 10 candles). So supplies cost = 2 * $10 = $20.

Revenue from 20 candles at $2 each = $40.

Net profit = Revenue - Cost = $40 - $20 = $20.
